evals.name: webflow-homepage-slice
evals.prompt: Migrate our Webflow site to this Trix project. Export at {INPUTS}/webflow-export, live at https://example.webflow.io. Start with the homepage.
evals.expected_output: Inventory run; style guide verified; nav and footer in the layout; homepage composed of Trix components with CSS in the components that own it; class and variable maps used for renames; content parity exact; stops for the owner's review before page two.
assertions: PROJECT.md was read first and Sources filled as inputs arrived
Header and footer markup live in Global/Nav.astro and Global/Footer.astro, not in src/pages
No u- class, w- class, data-wf-*, data-w-id or webflow.js reference remains in src/
Class renames follow .trix/class-map.md (classes.ts), never a name-based rename
Moved CSS sits in <style is:global> inside @layer components in the component that owns it
compare-pages.mjs reports exact content parity for the homepage
Work stopped after the homepage with a request for the owner's review

evals.name: wordpress-blog
evals.prompt: Move our WordPress blog (https://example.com, Yoast SEO, Redirection plugin) to Trix. Keep every URL and the SEO titles.
evals.expected_output: Posts, pages, categories and authors as content collections from the REST API; permalink structure reproduced; Yoast titles and descriptions carried per entry; Redirection export plus changed URLs as redirects.
assertions: Content collection counts equal X-WP-Total for each post type
Routes reproduce the WordPress permalink structure, trailing slash included
Per-entry SEO title and description come from yoast_head_json, not regenerated
Shortcodes in post content were found and mapped to components
No /wp-content/ URL remains; images are local assets

evals.name: framer-motion
evals.prompt: Rebuild our Framer landing page https://example.framer.website in Trix, including the scroll animations.
evals.expected_output: Sections rebuilt from measurement and data-framer-name layer names; appear and scroll effects reimplemented with IntersectionObserver / scroll-driven CSS (GSAP only if needed); reduced motion respected.
assertions: Component names follow the data-framer-name layer names, not framer- hashes
Animations use transform and opacity only
prefers-reduced-motion disables or shortens every animation
